clue.text: Giants fighting to eat before seeing big cheese

indicators.note: eating something takes it inside, so the wrestlers' word swallows the other piece

parts.note: sumo is Japanese wrestling between giant men
pre- is the prefix meaning before

explanation.surface: Battling giants stop for a meal before meeting the boss.
explanation.definitionFit: A big cheese is a slangy term for the person in charge, the top boss.

clue.text: Palms up, in effect, keeping so?

definitions.text: Palms up, in effect, keeping so?

indicators.note: keeping means holding within, so the run of letters is held inside these words

explanation.surface: Describing a hand turned upwards, and asking whether it effectively stays that way.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters sit across 'palmS UP IN Effect', and the whole clue doubles as the definition: a hand held palms up is in that position.
explanation.definitionFit: Lying or turned face upward is the anatomical meaning, as with an upturned hand.

clue.text: Staff cutting wages, farce

indicators.note: cutting into something means going inside it, so the rod sits within the pay

parts.note: wages are pay
a staff is a rod or stick

explanation.surface: Employees slashing salaries is a farce.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Staff' reads as employees but is a stick, ROD.
explanation.definitionFit: A parody is a mocking imitation, a farce or travesty of the real thing.

clue.text: Former Communist stronghold let Serbian out

indicators.note: out suggests letters thrown out of their order and rearranged

explanation.surface: A one-time Communist bastion released a Serbian prisoner.
explanation.definitionFit: The eastern half of the divided German city was the capital of Communist East Germany.

clue.text: Born to replace son in terrorist, he's in the White House

indicators.note: replacing puts one letter in place of another within the word

parts.note: Osama bin Laden was the al-Qaeda terrorist leader
b is the abbreviation for born, as in genealogies

explanation.surface: A child substituted into a terror plot reaches the presidential residence.
explanation.definitionFit: Barack Obama was the US president living in the White House when this was set in 2010.

clue.text: Drinker's hangover?

parts.note: not the headache next morning but the paunch that literally hangs over a heavy drinker's belt

explanation.surface: The morning-after misery of a heavy drinker.
explanation.definitionFit: A paunch built up from years of ale-drinking overhangs the trousers.

clue.text: Medical obstruction?

definitions.meaning: a medical is a physical examination of the whole body
in ice hockey, blocking an opponent with the body is a legal obstruction

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both a physical examination and, in ice hockey, a body block on an opponent.

clue.text: One withdrawn from silent act, coming up with a novel

indicators.note: in a down entry, coming up means the letters are read from the bottom upwards
withdrawn from tells us one letter is taken out of the act

parts.note: a mime is an act performed without words
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone retires from a mime performance and then turns up with a book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'withdrawn from' leaves MME, which 'coming up' turns to read upwards in this down entry; 'silent act' looks like a stage direction but is the act's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Emma is Jane Austen's novel about the matchmaking Emma Woodhouse.

clue.text: Piece having to wander in Kipling poem

parts.note: a piece is slang for a gun
to gad is to wander about idly

explanation.surface: A fragment that has to roam through a poem by Kipling.
explanation.definitionFit: Gunga Din is Rudyard Kipling's 1890 ballad about an Indian water-carrier.

clue.text: Fifty in boxes are untruthful

indicators.note: in places the numeral inside the word for televisions

parts.note: the box is British slang for television, so boxes are tellies
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Fifty television sets are telling lies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boxes' is British slang for TV sets, which are TELLIES.
explanation.definitionFit: To tell lies is a plain phrase for being untruthful, speaking falsehoods.

clue.text: Concentration evident, pushing cunning little wrigglers into back seat

indicators.note: pushing something into a place forces it inside
into says where the pushed pieces go, inside the seat

parts.note: a pillion is the rear seat of a motorcycle
art can mean cunning or craft
sperm are tiny wriggling cells

explanation.surface: An obvious focus, driving crafty tiny swimmers onto the motorbike's back seat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Evident' is only a link word; 'pushing ... into' splits the motorcycle seat after its first letter. A pillion is the passenger seat behind a motorcyclist.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a unit for measuring how concentrated a substance is in a mixture.

clue.text: Mad albino's upset stomach

indicators.note: upset means overturned or disturbed, so the letters are put in a new order

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: A crazy albino has an upset stomach.
explanation.definitionFit: Abdominal means relating to the belly, the stomach region, used attributively.

clue.text: Sea slug with one brown back limb

indicators.note: back means the colour word is read in reverse

parts.note: dun is a dull greyish-brown colour
I is the Roman numeral one
a limb of a tree is a branch

explanation.surface: A sea slug with a single brown rear limb.
explanation.definitionFit: Nudibranchs are brightly coloured shell-less marine molluscs, commonly called sea slugs.

clue.text: Beastly hanger-on wants everyone left to be inspired by genius

indicators.note: to be inspired is literally to be breathed in, so these pieces go inside the genius

parts.note: a wizard is a person of genius at something
all means everyone

explanation.surface: A clinging creature wants everybody remaining to take inspiration from a genius.
explanation.definitionFit: This reptile is a creature that clings to walls, a beast hanging on.

clue.text: Nine on call, cooking Italian food

indicators.note: cooking means mixing and changing, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Nine people on call are preparing Italian dishes.
explanation.definitionFit: Cannelloni are large pasta tubes, stuffed and baked, a classic Italian dish.

clue.text: Question in case romance is hopeless without its physical side

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the rearranged letters surround the other piece
hopeless suggests a mess, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: the physical side of a romance is sex

explanation.surface: Asking about a court case: a romance is doomed when the passion goes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hopeless' jumbles the two words into CROSAMINE; 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, not lacking, so those letters wrap the other piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Lawyers cross-examine by questioning the other side's witnesses in a court case.

clue.text: NASA equipment's opening action

parts.note: an opening is a gap or space
a legal action is a suit

explanation.surface: The opening move in a space agency's procedure.
explanation.definitionFit: Astronauts at NASA wear pressurised suits as protective equipment outside the craft.

clue.text: Lenin was taking party with me, after revolution, over the sea

indicators.note: revolution means turning round, so the two pieces are read backwards

parts.note: Lab is short for the Labour Party
taken as written
the Med is the Mediterranean Sea

explanation.surface: Lenin taking a political party along with the writer, after the Revolution, overseas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after revolution' gives EMBAL; 'over' in a down clue puts that above the sea. The definition is a sentence fragment: Lenin was preserved after death.
explanation.definitionFit: Lenin's body was preserved and displayed in a Red Square mausoleum, chemically treated after death.

clue.text: Flirtation non-starter, given marriage

indicators.note: non-starter here means without its first letter

parts.note: a dalliance is a casual flirtation

explanation.surface: A flirtation that goes nowhere, given a wedding.
explanation.definitionFit: An alliance can mean a union by marriage, especially between families.

clue.text: Male (classy) left bird seeking directions — men can't seem to do it!

definitions.text: men can't seem to do it!

parts.note: U means upper-class, as in the U and non-U distinction
the tit is a small bird
asking directions is what a lost traveller does, so seeking directions means asking

explanation.surface: A posh man abandons a woman while asking the way: men can't manage it!
explanation.walkthrough: U for upper-class is a dated British usage.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing several jobs at once is famously something men are said to be bad at.

clue.text: See 12
Hospital department on English course

parts.note: ENT is the ear, nose and throat department
re means on or concerning

explanation.surface: A hospital ward offering a course in English.
explanation.definitionFit: An entree is a course of a meal, the main dish in American usage.

clue.text: A boundary knocked over, producing turning point

indicators.note: knocked over means upended, so the cricket word is read backwards

parts.note: in cricket a six is a boundary hit clearing the rope on the full

explanation.surface: Hitting a cricket boundary that proves the decisive moment.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a ball hit over the boundary rope without bouncing scores six.
explanation.definitionFit: An axis is the line about which something turns or rotates.

clue.text: See 9
Where horses and hounds gather fleshy foods, they say

indicators.note: they say signals that the word is to be heard rather than read

parts.note: meats are foods of animal flesh

explanation.surface: Fox-hunting gatherings are, people say, carnivore cuisine.
explanation.definitionFit: Meets are the assemblies of riders and hounds before a fox hunt.

clue.text: Around lake, river from swell disconnected land

indicators.note: around means the lake letter is surrounded by the other letters
from signals taking the river letter away from the swell

parts.note: a rise is a swell or increase

explanation.surface: By a lake, a river rises from isolated ground.
explanation.walkthrough: RISE loses R to give ISE, which goes around L.
explanation.definitionFit: An isle is an island, land cut off from the mainland by water.

clue.text: Take poor clue as wee

parts.note: take, as in subtract, means minus

indicators.note: poor suggests badly made, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Treating a weak clue as something little.
explanation.definitionFit: Minuscule means extremely small, which Scots call wee.

clue.text: Broadcasting graceful dancing here?

definitions.meaning: being broadcast, transmitted on radio or television
an elegant dancer is said to be dancing ..., as if weightless

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means being broadcast, and is also where a light-footed dancer seems to move.

clue.text: River meeting city on the Danube measuring the most fathoms

parts.note: the Dee is a British river
Pest is the eastern half of Budapest, on the Danube

explanation.surface: A river joins a Danube city where the waters are deepest.
explanation.definitionFit: A fathom is a unit of water depth, so the most fathoms is the deepest.

clue.text: Rod lends 1p to forge

indicators.note: to forge is to hammer into a new shape, so the letters are reshaped

parts.note: 1 is read as the letter I and p is the abbreviation for penny

explanation.surface: A rod lends a penny towards forging.
explanation.definitionFit: A spindle is a slender rod on which thread is wound or something rotates.
